title: CLAUDE.md
text: reformat_data() main dispatcher — auto-detects input format routes specialized functions: - reformat_data_nca_to_modeling() — NCA-ready → NONMEM (separates dose events EVID=1 observations EVID=0) - reformat_data_modeling_to_modeling() — validation/cleanup NONMEM datasets (uppercase columns, MDV column) - reformat_data_sdtm_to_modeling() — SDTM domains (ADSL, DM, EX, PC, VS, LB) → NONMEM using admiral package; derives clinical covariates (BMI, BSA, CrCl, eGFR) - reformat_data_modeling_to_nca() — stub, yet implemented

title: CLAUDE.md
text: sample_covariates() dispatches method argument : - sample_covariates_mvtnorm() — fits multivariate normal observed data, samples - sample_covariates_bootstrap() — nonparametric resampling replacement - sample_covariates_mice() — multiple imputation via chained equations (predictive mean matching), using internal dependency-free mice_impute() (R/mice_impute.R) - sample_covariates_nhanes() — downloads/caches NHANES survey data; supports probability-proportional sampling via survey weights (WTMEC2YR) - sample_covariates_copulas() — fits vine copula (Zwep et al. 2024, rvinecopulib) kernel-density marginals observed covariates samples virtual subjects, reproducing full dependence structure (continuous covariates ) - sample_covariates_mice_timevarying() / sample_covariates_lme_timevarying() / sample_covariates_copulas_timevarying() — time-varying (longitudinal) covariate samplers. MICE resamples observed transitions via chained equations; LME fits per-covariate mixed-effects transition models; copulas (Zwep et al. 2024, rvinecopulib) fit vine copula per-subject polynomial-trajectory coefficients. two MICE/LME samplers share baseline_method ("mice"/"bootstrap") noise (multiplicative log-normal jitter) option baseline draw.

what: Putting it all together: anonymize_dataset() function
title: Anonymizing pharmacokinetic modeling datasets
text: function anonymize_dataset() combines steps described : simple data cleaning, sampling (time-varying) covariates, simulation concentration data. single call can now generate new dataset. vancomycin model (vanco_model.ferx) drives clearance CRCLf volumes FFM, covariates sample anonymize. structural columns (ID, EVID, AMT, TIME, DV, RATE) already use default names dataset, default dictionary applies. One additional step aims improve realism simulated data : draw 10 candidate covariate sets keep one whose simulated concentration data closely resembles original, judged score computes deviance original data. score can based covariates, simulated concentrations, . Additionally, round covariate data simulated concentration 4 significant digits, drop -LOQ observations. simulation step requires ferx package simulate concentrations. result ready--share pharmacometric dataset: IDs renumbered 1:n, identifying columns dropped, covariates resampled (rounded), concentrations re-simulated model.  covariate distribution CRCLf run looked like :
code: model_file <- system.file("extdata", "vanco_model.ferx", package = "irxforge") anon <- anonymize_dataset(   data         = csv,   method = "lme",   covariates   = c("FFM", "CRCLf"),    model_file   = model_file,   dictionary   = list(     ID = "ID", EVID = "EVID", AMT = "AMT",     TIME = "TIME", DV = "DV", RATE = "RATE"   ),   n_candidates = 10,              # draw 10 candidates, keep the closest to the original   score_on     = "concentration", # score each candidate on its simulated concentrations   sigdig       = 4,               # round covariates and simulated concentrations   loq          = 2.0,             # vancomycin LOQ (mg/L)   blq_method   = "remove",        # drop below-LOQ observation rows   seed         = 26 ) head(anon) #>   ID    TIME EVID  AMT RATE    DV MDV  FFM CRCLf #> 1  1  0.0000    1 1750 1000  0.00   1 62.8 65.04 #> 2  1  6.6167    0    0    0 15.13   0 62.8 65.04 #> 3  1 10.1000    2    0    0  0.00   1 62.8 73.74 #> 4  1 10.2000    1 1750 1000  0.00   1 62.8 73.74 #> 5  1 20.3833    2    0    0  0.00   1 62.8 72.98 #> 6  1 23.8000    2    0    0  0.00   1 62.8 75.09  # How close the selected candidate was to the original (lower = closer) attr(anon, "similarity_score") #> [1] 0.007480446 bind_rows(   csv |> mutate(source = "original"),   anon |> mutate(source = "simulated") ) |>   filter(EVID == 0) |>   ggplot(aes(x = TIME, y = DV, group = ID)) +     geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +     geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +     scale_y_log10() +     theme_bw() +     facet_wrap(~source) +     ggtitle("Original vs anonymized, simulated concentration-time profiles")

title: Anonymize a NONMEM-style dataset — anonymize_dataset
text: data original NONMEM-style data.frame tibble. covariates character vector covariates include anonymized dataset. May character(0) datasets without covariate columns: covariate sampling skipped, observed subject's dosing/observation design cloned (random order) onto renumbered subject 1:n concentrations simulated. model_file path FeRx model file used simulate concentrations. dictionary named list mapping expected NONMEM column names columns data. Supported keys ID, EVID, AMT, TIME, DV, optionally RATE. Defaults use names. method time-varying covariate sampler used resample covariates. "mice" (default) uses sample_covariates_mice_timevarying(), "lme" uses sample_covariates_lme_timevarying(), "copulas" uses sample_covariates_copulas_timevarying(). "mice" supports categorical covariates; "lme" "copulas" require covariates continuous. cat_covs optional character vector categorical covariates, addition factor character covariates (always treated categorical). Use numerically coded categorical covariates, e.g. SEX = 0/1, sampled continuous values. returned original numeric codes. loq optional numeric limit quantification. Simulated observations loq handled according blq_method. blq_method handle simulated observations loq. "remove" (default) removes -LOQ observation rows. "cens" keeps , sets DV 0, adds CENS column 1 -LOQ observations 0 otherwise. data contains MDV column, recomputed simulated data: 1 non-observation records observations missing DV, 0 otherwise (censored observations keep MDV = 0 flagged via CENS). sigdig number significant digits round sampled covariates simulated concentrations (DV) , via signif(), obscure values. Default 4. NULL disables rounding. Rounding applied loq comparison. n_candidates number independent candidates draw score observed data, keeping closest match. Default 1 (scoring; single candidate used). greater 1, candidate smallest distance observed data (see score_on) selected. chosen candidate's score attached result "similarity_score" attribute. similarity distribution-similarity metric used score candidates. "energy" (default) energy distance observed simulated feature matrices, standardized observed spread. Lower closer. score population-level, per-subject, push individual simulated subjects toward specific real subjects. score_on score candidates n_candidates > 1. "concentration" (default) scores simulated concentration-time data: candidate fully simulated (time, log concentration) observation cloud compared observed concentrations, PK simulation run per candidate. "covariate" scores sampled covariate trajectories (baseline, mean, slope within-subject SD per continuous covariate; per-subject time fraction level per categorical covariate), cheaper PK simulation run , selected covariate sample. seed optional integer seed used covariate sampling FeRx simulation. NULL (default) seed, call draws independently. ... additional arguments passed sample_covariates_mice_timevarying().

title: Anonymize a NONMEM-style dataset — anonymize_dataset
text: anonymized NONMEM-style data.frame, one block records per anonymized subject (ID 1:n). block clone one observed subject's dosing/observation design, returned ordered time within subject (stable sort TIME, records sharing time keep source order records missing time placed last). result carries attributes: "design_map": data.frame one row per anonymized subject columns ID (anonymized subject ID) DESIGN_ID (ID observed subject data whose design cloned, original type). Use relate anonymized subjects back source design without reconstructing event records. Note mapping links anonymized dataset source subjects, shared alongside anonymized data. "similarity_score": selected candidate's score n_candidates > 1, otherwise NULL.
